topics.title: Brute Force Strategy
topics.task: Max Finder: Read an integer N (size of array), followed by a line of N space-separated integers. Find and print the maximum value in the array.

topics.title: Linear Search
topics.task: Read N (array size), then a line of N space-separated integers, and finally a Target integer. Sequentially search for the Target and print its index. Print -1 if not found.

topics.title: Simple Sorting
topics.task: Bubble Sort: Read N (array size) and a line of N space-separated integers. Sort the array in ascending order using Bubble Sort and print the sorted integers separated by spaces.
